issue_context.title: select statement returns constant overflow
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)
```
tidb> create table t6 (a bigint);
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.00 sec)
tidb> insert into t6 values(9223372036854775807);
Query OK, 1 row affected (0.00 sec)
tidb> alter table t6 add unique key idx(a);
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.04 sec)
mysql> select * from t6 where a != 9223372036854775808;
ERROR 1690 (22003): constant 9223372036854775808 overflows bigint
```

<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)
```

+---------------------+
| a                   |
+---------------------+
| 9223372036854775807 |
+---------------------+
1 row in set (0.00 sec)
```


### 3. Affected version (Required)
master

review_comments: When the `isUnsiged = true`, we can return directly.
Do we need to consider `ast.EQ` and `ast.NullEQ` here?
Does the `mysql.TypeDouble` situation need to be dealt with?
Maybe we don't need to control the boundary about mysql.TypeDouble. When the value exceeds math.MaxFloat64, an error will be reported when sql parsing.
